observations: Photo 0 shows a black console with two black controllers placed on top. The console has a matte finish and visible ventilation grills on the side. The controllers have the standard PlayStation button layout (triangle, circle, cross, square) and analog sticks. A blue object with PlayStation symbols is visible to the left.

Photo 1 shows the same console from a side angle, with a hand holding one controller. The console’s front edge and ventilation slits are visible. The surface has some dust and minor scratches. A blue box with 'SONY' written on it is visible below the console.
The console appears to be a PlayStation 4 Slim model based on its size, shape, and design. The controllers match the PS4 DualShock 4 design.
No visible branding or model number is readable on the console itself in either photo. The 'SONY' logo is visible on a box below, not on the console.
The seller claims the console is 'hacked', includes two original controllers, HDMI, charging cable, and 8 games — none of which are visible in the photos.
